subject: Storify.ai trial: success playbook, owners, risks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Novak <lena@storify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-15T13:20:00Z
Subject: Storify.ai trial: recap + proposed kickoff (2-week POC)

Thanks for the call earlier, Lena — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Scope (agreed on call):
- 2-week functional trial against a subset of your production traffic (redacted).
- Endpoints: low-latency real-time generative and a batch embedding job for 50k sample tokens.
- Test harness: our workload runner + your sample dataset (S3 share).

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Availability: >= 99% during test window.
- Latency: p95 <= 300 ms for real-time endpoint at target QPS (25 RPS).
- Quality: top-1 accuracy >= 92% vs your baseline eval set (we'll exchange eval scripts).
- Cost target: token inference cost <= $0.35 per 1K tokens (goal, not hard limit).

Ownership / roles:
- Redwood AM / trial owner: Karthik Iyer (me) — commercial coordination, MAP, kickoff.
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — test harness, integration, runbook.
- Redwood runtime owner: Marcus Lin — escalation for runtime/kernel issues.
- Storify POC lead: Lena Novak — dataset, acceptance, procurement contact.

Immediate next steps:
1) I will share: trial-checklist.xlsx and SOW-draft-v1.pdf (attached).
2) Proposed kickoff: 2025-08-18 10:00 PT — 30 min (kickoff + tech clarifications).
3) Please confirm security/procurement contacts and whether you can share a redacted sample by EOD 8/17.

Known risks we discussed: quantized model behavior on long sequences; we'll include mitigations in the MAP.

If that looks good, I’ll lock the kickoff and share the mutual-action-plan CSV with owners and dates.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: trial-checklist.xlsx, SOW-draft-v1.pdf

From: Lena Novak <lena@storify.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon@storify.ai>, Procurement <procurement@storify.ai>, security@storify.ai
Date: 2025-08-15T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Storify.ai trial: recap + proposed kickoff (2-week POC)

Thanks, Karthik — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

1) Security/procurement contacts: Devon (security) and Procurement (alias) are on the thread. Devon will send a completed security questionnaire (attached) but wanted to flag two constraints up front:
   - No raw user identifiers can leave our VPC during the trial (redaction required).
   - All keys must be customer-managed (KMS) where possible.

2) Timeline: procurement will try to get PO in place by 2025-08-21 but cannot guarantee. Can you confirm whether the trial can start while procurement finalizes paperwork (we typically run trials under an MSA + NDA)?

3) Dataset: we can share a ~50k token redacted sample by 8/17.

Please include answers to the SOC2 / logs question in the MAP. I attached the security questionnaire Devon filled so you can see the initial items.

—Lena
Lena Novak
Head of ML Product | Storify.ai
lena@storify.ai

Attachment: security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Novak <lena@storify.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-16T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Storify.ai trial: recap + proposed kickoff (2-week POC)

Adding the implementation plan and a compact risk register so everyone has visibility. I uploaded the mutual-action-plan.csv to the Drive link Karthik shared and attached a copy. High-level plan below: 

Week 0 (prep, 8/18 kickoff): dataset exchange, test harness access, S3 role + KMS setup, confirm redaction workflow. Owners: Karthik (comm), Ben (SE), Lena (dataset).
Week 1: run baseline, collect perf/quality metrics, iterate on config (batching/quant).
Week 2: stress run at target QPS, final evaluation vs acceptance criteria, handoff/lessons.

Risk register (short):
- Blocker: quantized inference fails on sequences > 4096 (impact: trial can't validate at scale). Mitigation: temporary truncation to 4096 + enable partial-kv-cache; SE to run local repro and provide a patch candidate. Escalation: Marcus (runtime) -> Marissa (CS lead) -> Karthik (AM).
- Medium: procurement delay — mitigation: run trial on mutual NDA + SOW; accept PO later. Escalation: Karthik -> Sales Ops.
- Low: dataset redaction gaps — mitigation: redaction checklist; sample share before kickoff.

Please review owners and escalation steps; if anything should go to legal or security, call it out and we’ll loop them in.

Thanks,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Novak <lena@storify.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@storify.ai>
Date: 2025-08-16T14:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Storify.ai trial: MAP + success metrics (updated)

Thanks, Marissa — updated MAP attached and a concise success-playbook below for sign-off.

Success playbook (finalized items — please confirm by 8/17):
- Data: redacted sample (<=50k tokens) provided by Storify; Redwood will only store redacted logs for trial window and delete after 30 days unless agreed otherwise.
- Security: SOC2 evidence available; we will provide our SOC2 summary + audit contact. Customer-managed KMS supported for encryption-at-rest.
- Metrics (concrete):
  * Availability >= 99% during window
  * Latency p95 <= 300ms (real-time) at 25 RPS
  * Quality: top-1 accuracy >= 92% on your eval script
  * Cost: target <= $0.35 / 1K tokens (operational goal)
- Test harness changes: temporary truncation to 4096 tokens if needed to validate pipeline (Ben to confirm).

Kickoff confirmed: 2025-08-18 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Please reply-all with explicit sign-off on the playbook (Lena + security) so we can spin up infra Monday morning.

—Karthik

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.csv, SOW-draft-v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Novak <lena@storify.ai>
Date: 2025-08-17T11:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Storify.ai trial: MAP + success metrics (technical note)

Quick technical update after running the sample through our quantized inference stack: 

Repro steps: used Storify sample (redacted) with batch config=8 and max_seq_len=8192 on int8 build. Observed deterministic OOM / kernel fault when sequence lengths exceed ~4100 tokens on our current quantized kernels.

Impact: this prevents us from validating long-sequence behavior under int8 quantization for the trial run. 

Workarounds and ETA: 
- Short-term (approved by runtime): truncate inputs to 4096 tokens in the harness (no model change) — allows functional trial validation today.
- Medium-term: Marcus will apply a kernel pre-check and a small patch to handle split-kv segments; ETA for customer environment: ~3 business days after approval (target 2025-08-20).
- Long-term: kernel robustness change in next patch cycle (~2 weeks).

If short-term workaround is acceptable to Storify, we can proceed without delay. If Storify needs untruncated behavior for acceptance, we should consider a short delay until the patch lands. 

CC'ing Marcus for runbook/escalation. Marcus - if we hit a regression after patch, escalate to runtime engineering on-call and notify Marissa/Karthik.

—Ben
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Lena Novak <lena@storify.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Clark <devon@storify.ai>, Procurement <procurement@storify.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-18T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Storify.ai trial: MAP + success metrics (technical note)

Thanks, team — good to know and thanks for the clear mitigation path. We accept the short-term workaround (truncate to 4096) so the trial can start on 8/18. A few items from my side: 

- Procurement: we will prioritize the PO but expect to have it by 8/21. We are OK starting the trial under the SOW + mutual NDA; please send the DocuSign link for signatures.
- Security: Devon confirmed the redaction approach is acceptable for the trial. He also asked for SOC2 summary + contact (Marcus / Marissa please share).
- Escalation: if the kernel patch is not available by 2025-08-20 (end of day) we request escalation to the CTO’s office to avoid trial delay. Please confirm the escalation chain and expected response SLA.
- Weekly sync: propose Tuesday 30-min stand-up during trial window to triage blockers (first one 8/19).

Ben — please proceed with the truncation change and document the config in the MAP. Marcus — please confirm ETA for the patch and add runtime-oncall steps to the escalation path in the CSV.

Once we have the DocuSign link and SOC2 summary, we will confirm the kickoff invite.

Best,
Lena Novak
Head of ML Product | Storify.ai
lena@storify.ai
